# Geometry — A Four-Week Course

> A free, self-paced Geometry course with 29 short lectures, unlimited practice, and an interactive tutor. No account needed.

## Course weeks

- [Week 1 — Foundations, reasoning, and proof](/weeks/1)
- [Week 2 — Triangles, congruence, and quadrilaterals](/weeks/2)
- [Week 3 — Similarity, right triangles, and circles](/weeks/3)
- [Week 4 — Area, volume, and beyond Euclid](/weeks/4)

The course also includes two homeworks, an 8-question midterm, and a 10-question final. Individual lessons are available at `/lectures/{id}`.
